crime: In earlier courtyard lessons, the victim steadied the crossbow for {WITCH_NAME} and guided her aim. Today, they took those guiding hands away, leaving her to aim unaided, then stepped back from the firing line until they stood directly behind her.

{WITCH_NAME} fired a bolt toward a tree, then moved sideways out of its path. While it was still flying outward, her Magic reversed it. The bolt raced back nock-first, pierced the victim's chest, and killed them.

A prisoner found the bolt's point protruding from the front of the victim's chest. Although that prisoner remembered seeing {WITCH_NAME} fire toward the tree, the protruding point made the prisoners think the fatal bolt had passed through the victim from behind. But a prisoner examined the victim's back and found the skin unpierced. The intact back exposed the trick: the fatal bolt was the outward shot, turned back to strike from the front.
fields.epitaph: Letting go meant trusting her to stand on her own. She never understood.
execution: The execution stand holds the witch flat on her back beneath a pendulum blade. The blade begins to swing. Each time it returns, it cuts deeper into her chest before sweeping away. Even after she lies motionless, it keeps coming back.

magic.name: Reverse Course
magic.text: She can reverse the direction of anything physical that's moving.
